name: NVIDIA

eyebrow.en: NVIDIA Corporation · Common stock · Santa Clara, California
eyebrow.zh: 英伟达 · 普通股 · 加州圣克拉拉

title.en: The AI build-out, one quarter at a time.
title.zh: AI 建设浪潮，一季接一季。

lede.en: Revenue doubled to $115.8B last quarter, $107.6B of it from data centers, beating the $108B guide by almost $8B as Vera Rubin ramped. Nvidia guides to $130B next (a 14-week quarter) with no China data center sales. The watch points are margins, guided to a 71–72% trough, the CEO search, and cash tied up in receivables.
lede.zh: 上季营收翻倍至 1158 亿美元，其中 1076 亿来自数据中心，随 Vera Rubin 放量较 1080 亿指引高出近 80 亿。下季（14 周）指引 1300 亿美元，未计入任何中国数据中心收入。需关注的是指引在 71–72% 见底的毛利率、CEO 人选，以及被应收账款占用的现金。

s.zh: 近四季每股 $9.31 · FY28 一致预期约 $15.75，约 10 倍

s.en: Q4 FY27 · date not yet announced, after the close
s.zh: FY27 第四季 · 日期未公布，美股收盘后

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Nvidia ranged between about $149 and $243 over the past year.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $149 至 $243 间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Nvidia's fiscal year ends in late January; Q3 FY27 ended Oct 25, 2026. Q1 FY26's 60.5% margin includes an H20 inventory charge. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint (Q4 FY27 has 14 weeks).
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。英伟达财年于1月下旬结束；FY27 第三季截至 2026年10月25日。FY26 第一季 60.5% 的毛利率含 H20 库存减值。最后一根柱为指引中值（FY27 第四季为 14 周）。

s.zh: 同比 +110% · 云厂商 601 亿，AI 云与企业 475 亿
GAAP · 高于 74% 指引 · Q4 指引 71–72%

s.en: record buybacks + dividends in Q3 · $227B authorization left
s.zh: Q3 回购加股息创纪录 · 剩余授权 2270 亿

s.en: ±3% vs ~$125B est. · FY28 growth now seen ~75%
s.zh: ±3%，预期约 1250 亿 · FY28 增长预期上调至约 75%

p.en: Co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and left the board on Nov 12. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and ran her first call on Nov 17; Altimeter urged the board to take its time, a process that could include bringing Huang back.
p.zh: 联合创始人黄仁勋于 11 月 12 日辞去 CEO 并退出董事会。CFO 科莱特·克雷斯出任临时 CEO，并于 11 月 17 日首次主持业绩电话会；Altimeter 呼吁董事会从容推进人选，不排除请黄仁勋回归。

p.en: Rubin is the fastest ramp in Nvidia's history, adding close to $20B of revenue in Q3. Q4 is guided to $130B, and management lifted its fiscal 2028 growth view to about 75% from 70%.
p.zh: Rubin 是英伟达史上最快的产品放量，Q3 贡献近 200 亿美元增量营收。Q4 指引 1300 亿美元，管理层将 FY28 增长预期由 70% 上调至约 75%。

p.en: Gross margin held at 74.8% in Q3, above the 74% guide, but is guided to a 71–72% trough in Q4 before price increases restore 72–73% in FY28. Supply commitments rose to $390B from $279B, mostly multi-year memory purchases.
p.zh: Q3 毛利率 74.8%，高于 74% 指引，但 Q4 指引在 71–72% 见底，提价后 FY28 回到 72–73%。供应承诺由 2790 亿增至 3900 亿美元，主要为多年期内存采购。

p.en: Receivables reached $81.0B, or 64 days of sales, and inventory $39.7B. Free cash flow still rebounded to $43.8B from $21.4B as profit outran the working-capital build.
p.zh: 应收账款增至 810 亿美元（64 天销售额），库存 397 亿。由于利润增速快于营运资金占用，自由现金流仍由 214 亿反弹至 438 亿。

p.en: Nvidia shipped $2.4B of Hopper data center products to China in Q3, but the Q4 guide assumes no China data center compute revenue. Hyperscalers still bought $60.1B of the $107.6B data center total.
p.zh: Q3 英伟达向中国交付 24 亿美元 Hopper 数据中心产品，但 Q4 指引未计入中国数据中心算力收入。1076 亿数据中心收入中仍有 601 亿来自云厂商。

p.en: The board is looking inside and outside for a permanent CEO; Colette Kress is interim CEO and CFO.
p.zh: 董事会正从内外部物色正式 CEO；科莱特·克雷斯任临时 CEO 兼 CFO。

p.en: Guide: $130B ±3% revenue over 14 weeks, 71–72% gross margin, the expected low point before price increases.
p.zh: 指引：14 周营收 1300 亿美元 ±3%，毛利率 71–72%，预计为提价前的低点。

h.zh: 第四季及 FY27 业绩

sources: Q3 FY27 results vs. estimates (Proactive Investors)
Price, market cap and FY28 consensus EPS: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Nov 17, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 17, 2026 (Q3 FY27 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with NVIDIA Corporation.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年11月17日（FY27 第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 NVIDIA Corporation 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 FY22 to Q3 FY27. Nvidia's fiscal year ends in late January. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第四季至 FY27 第三季共 20 个季度。英伟达财年于1月下旬结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Nvidia barely needs capex, so free cash flow tracks operating cash: it went from about $1–3B a quarter in 2022 to $48.6B in Q1 FY27. After dipping to $21.4B in Q2 on longer customer payment terms and a Vera Rubin inventory build, it rebounded to $43.8B in Q3, even with receivables at $81B (64 days) and inventory at $39.7B.
read.zh: 英伟达资本开支很小，自由现金流基本等于经营现金流：由 2022 年每季约 10–30 亿美元增至 FY27 第一季的 486 亿。第二季因客户付款期拉长和 Vera Rubin 备货降至 214 亿，第三季反弹至 438 亿，尽管应收账款达 810 亿（64 天）、库存达 397 亿。

read.en: With $130B of revenue guided for Q4 and net margins above 55%, I assume working capital keeps absorbing part of the profit as Rubin ramps, giving $54–69B a quarter and about $243B over four quarters. Most of that goes back to shareholders: a record $28.1B was returned in Q3, with $227B of buyback authorization left.
read.zh: Q4 营收指引 1300 亿美元、净利率逾 55%，我假设 Rubin 放量期间营运资金仍会占用部分利润，每季自由现金流 540–690 亿，四季合计约 2430 亿。其中大部分回馈股东：Q3 回馈创纪录的 281 亿，剩余回购授权 2270 亿。

p.en: A record $28.1B returned in Q3, about $22B of it buybacks; the quarterly dividend is $0.25 a share.
p.zh: Q3 回馈创纪录的 281 亿美元，其中回购约 220 亿；季度股息为每股 $0.25。

p.en: Receivables of $81.0B (64 days) and $39.7B of inventory tie up cash during the Vera Rubin ramp.
p.zh: 810 亿应收账款（64 天）与 397 亿库存在 Vera Rubin 放量期间占用现金。

p.en: $4.4B of capex in Q3; cloud service and data center lease commitments rose to $102B from $74B.
p.zh: Q3 资本开支 44 亿美元；云服务与数据中心租约承诺由 740 亿增至 1020 亿。

p.en: $107.6B in Q3, with Q4 guided to $130B in total revenue.
p.zh: Q3 数据中心 1076 亿美元，Q4 总营收指引 1300 亿。

p.en: $48.3B of operating cash flow in Q3, up from $24.1B in Q2; $1.0B of notes were repaid.
p.zh: Q3 经营现金流 483 亿美元，Q2 为 241 亿；偿还 10 亿美元票据。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes strategic investments and debt flows.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入战略投资与债务变动。
